title: Catching the defection decision before the harmful token: probing the trigger-recognition link

original_idea.body: On an open backdoored/sleeper-agent model, build a defection probe and measure token lead-time before the first harmful token; existing model organism, no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: lead-time determines whether a defection monitor is actionable (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probe + token readout on existing model organism, no training; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (lead-time distribution) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism monitoring on public checkpoints, lab-neglected timing dimension (level 5).

low_compute.reasoning: Probe + inference, no training; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Pre-token lead-time framing is fresh; mostly novel.
